subject: Prioritization matrix for deployment, SLA, latency & cost — post-demo
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@medipro.com>, Leah Torres <ltorres@medipro.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Prioritization matrix for deployment, SLA, latency & cost — post-demo

Hi Amit / Leah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick written recap so we have a shared checklist and clear next steps. Below I pulled together the things you flagged as decision drivers and a suggested priority matrix. Please confirm any corrections.

High-level takeaways:
- Economic buyer: Amit Shah (in procurement loop)
- Security / compliance: Leah Torres (security & privacy) — BAA + SOC 2 baseline required
- Procurement timeline: target decision in ~4–6 weeks, final contract following procurement review

Decision criteria (as discussed):
- Latency: target p95 inference latency in-prod (US-East) — you indicated ~120–150 ms target; please confirm firm target
- Cost: target per-1k-token unit to budget against — you mentioned cost sensitivity; need to verify acceptable range (ballpark: $0.015–$0.025 / 1k tokens)
- Deployment mode: preference for Private VPC for PHI/regulatory reasons (you said likely), but open to Dedicated if timeline faster
- SLA: 99.9% uptime desired; specific availability / credit language TBD by procurement

What I attached: a 1-page prioritization matrix (redwood-deploy-options-quick-matrix.xlsx) and our starter SLA term sheet (starter-sla-term-sheet.pdf) — both intended to accelerate procurement conversations.

Suggested next steps:
1) Amit/Leah — confirm latency target (p95) and cost band you need us to optimize for.
2) We run a quick benchmark with your sample payloads (we can do hosted test or bring Dedicated nodes) — propose this week or early next.
3) Security: Leah, if you can share the baseline list (SOC2 scope, BAA triggers, network diagram), our security team will prepare the evidence pack.
4) Schedule: suggest a 30-min follow-up on Wed (May 19) to align procurement + security owners.

If you prefer a short matrix call instead of a doc pass, happy to run through live.

Thanks —

Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prioritization matrix for deployment, SLA, latency & cost — post-demo

Monica —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side:

- Latency: our business stakeholders will accept up to 150 ms p95 for the primary use case (real-time triage), but they want <120 ms p95 if we go to the Dedicated option and the model remains the same. So please map both: Hosted / Dedicated / Private expected p95 ranges.
- Cost: we plan to budget around $0.02 / 1k tokens initially; we may stretch to $0.015 if the latency gains are compelling.
- Deployment mode: because Protected Health Information (PHI) may be involved, our Security/Privacy team prefers Private VPC deployment. That said, procurement is sensitive to time-to-production — if Dedicated gets us there faster with equivalent controls, we will consider it.
- Compliance: we do require SOC 2 Type II evidence and a BAA. I'll have Leah share the formal questionnaire and our network diagram.

Procurement note: our lead buyer (Meena Rao) will join on the procurement call — timeline still 4–6 weeks but Meena will own the contract terms.

Next actions from our side: Leah will send the security questionnaire and the network diagram by EOD tomorrow. Meena will be copied once she’s back from travel (returns Tue). Please include an estimated delta in cost/latency across Hosted, Dedicated, Private in the matrix.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Product Operations | MediPro Health Systems
amit.shah@medipro.com | +1 (617) 555-4422

Attachment: medipro-sla-reqs.docx (security questionnaire)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@medipro.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prioritization matrix for deployment, SLA, latency & cost — post-demo

Amit / Monica / Sean —

Thanks — a few operational clarifications and a proposed plan so we can be prescriptive for procurement:

1) Mapping latency expectations to deployment modes (approximate):
   - Hosted API (multi-tenant, US-East): expect 140–220 ms p95 for the model family we demoed; good for fast piloting but variable depending on burst load.
   - Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool): typically 100–160 ms p95 with proper instance sizing and continuous batching config; gives predictable latency and easier SLA commitments.
   - Private (VPC / customer-managed): we can hit 90–140 ms p95 in many on-prem or colocated cloud setups depending on network proximity and instance type — best for PHI use cases but requires procurement + infra setup time.

2) Cost tradeoffs (high-level):
   - Hosted: lower startup friction, higher unit cost at scale; good if you need fastest path to test.
   - Dedicated: mid-tier unit cost with reserved commitment; best balance for steady production throughput.
   - Private: lowest long-run unit cost for committed on-prem/cloud infra but higher setup and operational overhead.

3) SLA: we can propose 99.9% platform availability for Dedicated and Private. Hosted SLA varies by account tier; we can propose a custom SLA if you move to a committed plan. Credits and MTTR definitions will be in the term sheet.

Next steps we propose from Redwood:
- We’ll produce an updated matrix showing expected p95 ranges and ballpark unit costs for each mode using the numbers above (deliverable: updated matrix + recommended option).
- Run a 1–2 day benchmark on Dedicated with low-latency instance configs (we can use a sample of your payloads if you provide them) — objective: validate whether we hit 120 ms p95.
- Security: once Leah shares the questionnaire and network diagram, our security lead will assemble the SOC2 artifacts and BAA draft.

Timing: Monica / Sean — can we schedule the follow-up for Wed May 19, 11:00am PT? I’ll reserve a slot and include our security lead if Leah’s questionnaire lands earlier.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0987

We’ll plan to review the updated matrix and kick off the benchmark after the call.

Amit
